title: BSOD Pet
summary: A touch companion for your Walkman
description: Meet BSOD, a small offline companion for X1000. Tap to greet it, offer a treat, play, or let it rest and tap to wake. It waves, walks and tinkers with a laptop on its own. Chinese controls and UTF-8 text use an external bitmap font. Interactions save on user storage; reset requires confirmation. No hunger chores, network account or live Codex connection. Physical-player qualification is pending.
changes: Adds a dedicated monitor-robot icon, packaged introduction and release notes. Includes Chinese text, a bounded glyph cache and menu-only exit. Existing pet state is retained.
